verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships an OpenAI-compatible API (and Anthropic Messages API) that coding agents/IDE clients can point at as a drop-in backend, plus native tool/function-calling support with an autoparser for gguf models, which is exactly what agentic coding tools need for tool use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation from a real coding agent (e.g., Cursor/Continue/Aider) successfully using LocalAI as backend, and any OpenAPI spec artifact (probe found 404s).
